verdict.rationale: Ramp documents custom CSV exports and an open API (ramp-docs-12). It also publishes a 174-path OpenAPI spec for programmatic reads of transactions, banking and other resources (ramp-probe-5, ramp-docs-19, ramp-supp-banking-api), and admins can 'pull full spend exports' via MCP (ramp-supp-ai-agents-channels). So data can be extracted in open formats piecemeal. However, nothing documents a one-shot complete account export or an offboarding/data-portability path, so 'export all data and leave' relies on stitching together API calls and CSVs. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export covering all data types (receipts, bills, approvals, audit logs), a documented offboarding/portability process, and independent or hands-on corroboration that exports are complete.
